stories.title: There's a new way to break RSA that's faster than anything we've seen before
stories.excerpt: Until now, cryptographers thought factoring was the only way to break RSA. Not anymore.
stories.lead: The forgery attack drops these levels to 265, 290, and 2119 for 1024-, 2048-, and 4096-bit keys respectively. stories.title: How to Get Started With Jev in Python
stories.excerpt: Connect a Python script to the Jev model with the TypeSafe SDK and OpenRouter, then replace brittle input checks with Noul, Score, and Choice answers.
stories.lead:
When your script asks a user a basic yes-or-no question, they might type yes, Y, no!, or yeah. As a programmer, you have to guess every way they might answer, so your Python script needs to account for that. With the newly released Jev AI model, you can ease the load on your if statements and try to make sense of all human replies.

stories.lead:
In this quiz, you’ll test your understanding of The Terminal: First Steps and Useful Commands for Python Developers.

By working through this quiz, you’ll revisit how to find your way around the file system, create and inspect files, set up a virtual environment, install packages with pip, and take snapshots of your code with Git.

stories.title: Hundreds of thousands expected in Paris for Pope's visit
stories.excerpt: The highpoint of his time in Paris will be a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people.
stories.lead:
Pope Leo XIV embarks on a four-day visit to France on Friday, with the highpoint being a giant Mass attended by more than half a million people in central Paris.

For Saturday's afternoon celebration, an altar has been built on the Place de la Concorde and a large area around the Champs-Élysées sealed off by police.

Some 600,000 Catholic faithful are expected to cram the avenue up to the Arc de Triomphe and beyond.

stories.lead:
Good morning, and welcome to our rolling coverage of business, the financial markets and the world economy.

UK consumer confidence has surprisingly hit a two-year high this morning, but the recovery could be faltering as inflation climbs.

Research group GfK has reported that its Consumer Confidence Barometer rose to -13 in September, a rise of one point compared with August, with people more optimistic about their personal finances and the wider economy.

stories.title: Imani Clemons Joins Indiana University as Assistant Coach
stories.excerpt: Indiana University's women's water polo team has hired Imani Clemons as assistant coach for the 2026-2027 season. The post Imani Clemons Joins Indiana University as Assistant Coach appeared first on Collegiate Water Polo Association .
stories.lead:
BLOOMINGTON, Ind. – Indiana University’s women’s water polo team has hired Imani Clemons as assistant coach for the 2026-2027 season.

“We couldn’t be more excited to welcome Imani to Indiana,” said Indiana head coach Taylor McInerney.

“She is an exceptional person with tremendous character, and her experience and perspective as both a player and coach will make an immediate impact on our program. Imani shares our vision for the future of Indiana water polo and our commitment to building a program that consistently competes for championships. Most importantly, she will be a great resource for our student-athletes and be an incredible addition to the culture we’re continuing to build.”

stories.title: Water Polo Heads West for Ranked Competition
stories.excerpt: The 2026 Fordham water polo squad, ranked tied for fourth in the nation, continues its 2026 season this weekend by traveling to California to face nationally-ranked competition.
stories.lead:
THE OFFICIAL WEBSITE OF FORDHAM UNIVERSITY ATHLETICS

Bronx, N.Y. - The 2026 Fordham water polo squad, ranked tied for fourth in the nation, continues its 2026 season this weekend by traveling to California to face nationally-ranked competition. The Rams open play on Saturday, September 26, with a match against #1 UCLA at 8:00 p.m. (EST) and then battle #6 Long Beach State on Sunday, September 28 at 3:00 p.m. (EST) before closing out the trip against #15 Cal Baptist on Monday, September 29 at 2:00 p.m. (EST).

The Rams are 9-0 on the season and is coming off conference wins against Bucknell, Mount St. Mary's, and Mercyhurst last weekend at the Bucknell Invitational.
